Premium realistic nursery container product photography. ONE wide landscape contact sheet in EXACTLY 3 columns and 2 rows of SIX equal SQUARE frames. No borders, gutters or text. Every pot EMPTY, no plants, no soil, no accessories, no labels or logos. Each complete object fits comfortably inside its frame at consistent visual scale, about 60% of tile width and height, with at least 15% margin on all sides. Full rims and full bases visible. Hanging types: complete cord or chain and top hook must be visible, suspended from hook, with ground below; no cropped straps. Bags: open empty upright bags, realistic seams. Each frame is one distinct design of ONLY the named category. Order left to right then top to bottom:
1. forest green round tapered plastic nursery pot with rolled rim
2. charcoal square tapered plastic planter
3. warm ivory round plastic pot with subtle vertical ribs
4. terracotta coloured long rectangular plastic balcony trough
5. sage green low wide plastic bowl planter
6. matte sand tall tapered plastic planter
Category: Plastic Pots. All six cells same dimensions and consistent visual scale.
